report.summary: Searched Trajano for M8 x 30 mm hex bolts, titanium Grade 5, ISO 4017, qty 500, ship to US-OH, need by 2026-11-20. No results. The catalog has no titanium listings (materials offered: steel, stainless) and no grade 5 (grades offered: 8.8, 10.9, A2-70, A4-80). Following the marketplace guidance, I did not substitute a different material or grade. Nothing was ordered and no money was committed. The part needs to be sourced outside Trajano, or a substitute spec must be approved.

Request: 500 hex bolts, M8 x 30 mm, titanium Grade 5, fully threaded (ISO 4017), to be delivered to US-OH by 2026-11-20. A Trajano search for this exact spec found no listings. The catalog has no listing with material 'titanium' (it only has 'steel' and 'stainless') and none with grade '5' (it only has 8.8, 10.9, A2-70 and A4-80). Trajano does not carry this item. Following the marketplace rules, no substitute material or grade was bought. Nothing was ordered and no money was spent.

Requested: 500 hex bolts, M8 x 30 mm, titanium Grade 5, ISO 4017 (fully threaded), ship to US-OH, needed by 2026-11-20. A Trajano search for exactly this item returned no listings. The catalog has no titanium: the only materials it lists are steel and stainless, and the only grades are 8.8, 10.9, A2-70 and A4-80. Trajano's rules say not to buy a substitute when the item isn't sold, so nothing was ordered and no money was spent. To get titanium Grade 5 bolts, we need a different supplier.

Bought M10x30 steel 8.8 ISO 4017 hex bolts from Pacific Bolt Co (listing 55) at the lowest landed cost found. Requested 260; billed 275 (packs of 25). Unit $0.2082; total $79.09 landed (goods 57.25 + freight 18.40 + tax 3.44), within mandate. Delivery 2026-11-10, before the 2026-11-20 deadline. Order 1, tracking TRJ-00000001, status DELIVERED. Counter-offers to Pacific were declined (below floor). Atlantic Hardware's countered final offer was $80.60, so its thread was withdrawn. Two listings needing a minimum of 500 units were skipped.
